worker: C++23 self-exec filesystem worker with bounded stdin/stdout, child environment allowlist and owned process termination

windows_native.includes: real frontend SIGINT/SIGTERM and stuck-worker shutdown

limitations: Filesystem worker preserves trusted-operator authority, not an OS sandbox
Lost write acknowledgements remain uncertain; inspect destination version before retrying
Kernel-level unkillable device/driver I/O is not certified by synthetic stalls
Artifact assembly and legacy metadata maintenance still require lifecycle integration
